title: SecretGen: Privacy Recovery on Pre-Trained Models via Distribution Discrimination
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The key finding is that the proposed method, SecretGen, can effectively recover private training data (faces) from pre-trained models, even without ground truth labels, highlighting significant privacy risks in sharing such models.
